How the numbers are built
Growth on a year earlier
Only companies with a figure in both the quarter and the same quarter a year before are counted, so new listings and late filers do not move it.
Non-financials
Every company outside the GICS Financials sector. All revenue, margin, capex and leverage figures use this group unless a sector is chosen.
US dollar reporters
Companies that report in dollars are converted to rupiah, flows at the quarter's average rate and balance-sheet items at the quarter-end rate. The rates are worked out from the data itself.
Free pull
Figures from TradingView and StockAnalysis that fill cells Bloomberg left blank. Operating income, capex, cash flow, debt and cash are defined differently by each provider, so those filled cells are approximate. For financial companies only net income, assets, liabilities and equity are filled.
Contribution
A company's or sector's change on a year earlier, divided by the scope's total a year earlier. Contributions add up to the scope's growth, so they show who moved the total, which a growth rate alone does not.
Reported so far
The share of last year's revenue that came from companies which already have a figure for this quarter. Below roughly 80%, treat the quarter as incomplete.
